children: AguilaTrades’ BTC short position earned another $6.87 million, while a 10-day rolling short strategy turned $610,000 into $10.21 million.

According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember said the trader, whose address is 0x1f250Df59A777d61Cb8bd043c12970F3AFE4F925, increased the amount about 17-fold by rolling BTC short positions over the past 10 days. The source said AguilaTrades lost $39 million through rolling trades last year and has recently recovered about $10 million through the strategy.

title: AguilaTrades' BTC Short Earns Another $6.87 Million as 10-Day Rolling Short Turns $610,000 Into $10.21 Million
